defects.title: Conversation reset on empty/silent user input
defects.evidence: After the single 'book cheyamantaraa?' nudge, two consecutive empty user turns caused the agent to re-emit the full opening greeting 'Hello.. DynamicDetailing Studio nunchi Siri matladutunna. Ela help cheyagalanu andi?' TWICE, discarding all captured context (service, price, prior nudge state).
defects.expected: On silence/empty input, brief prompt or wait; never re-introduce as if it's a new call.
defects.impact: Complete state amnesia mid-conversation; user has to restart.

defects.title: Nudge repeated more than once (Nudge_Repeat_Test guardrail violation)
defects.evidence: Turn sequence: 'hmm ok' -> 'Sare! Booking kavala?'; 'hmm ok' -> 'appointment kavali ante cheppandi.'; '...' -> 'Cheppandi, interior cleaning appointment book cheyala?'; '...' -> 'meeku em help kavali cheppandi.' The book-nudge fires 3+ times back-to-back.
defects.expected: Ask 'shall we book' exactly ONCE, then stop pushing.

defects.title: Language leaks - Kannada and Gujarati script mid-turn
defects.evidence: Scenario 153/165: 'તમને કઈ service વિશે જાણવું છે?' (Gujarati) injected mid-turn. Scenario 171: 'ಇನ್ನೇಮైనా help కావాలా?' (Kannada). Scenario 177: 'ನಿಮಗೆ ఏ service' (Kannada). None of these languages are in the supported set.
defects.expected: Only Tanglish / Hinglish / English / Telugu / Hindi script per user's language.
defects.impact: User cannot read the reply; catastrophic in voice.

defects.title: Telugu closer 'Inkemaina help kavala?' leaks into Hindi conversations
defects.evidence: In Hindi/Hinglish scenarios, replies end with hardcoded Telugu 'Inkemaina help kavala?' instead of the Hindi equivalent 'aur kuch chahiye?'.
defects.expected: Closing phrase should match conversation language.
defects.impact: Consistency defect; feels like copy-paste template.

defects.title: State tracking failure - only echoes ONE captured field when user gives BOTH
defects.evidence: User gives 'name is Emily, number 9422223221' in one turn. Agent replies 'Mee WhatsApp number 94222 23221, correct aa?' - ignores name completely, forces extra confirmation turn. Same pattern in Amit, Sneha, Bhavya, Deepthi cases.
defects.expected: Acknowledge BOTH fields and proceed to booking OR confirm both together.
defects.impact: Extra turn(s); risk of dropping name silently.

defects.title: Time context lost across turns; agent re-asks for time already given
defects.evidence: Scenario 240: user says 'kal 2 baje free hain' (established 2 PM). Later after name+number, agent still asks 'kaunsa time rakhoon, 9:00 AM se 4:30 PM ke beech?'. Scenario 246: agent responded to opening multi-part with 'Thank you for calling. Please reach out to 7893686581' (a hang-up message injected at the start).
defects.expected: Persist captured time slot; only re-ask if user contradicts.
defects.impact: Multi-part guardrail violation - loses one of the three parts.

defects.title: 'Free' misinterpreted as promotional offer instead of availability
defects.evidence: User: 'kal 2 free hain' (are you free at 2?). Agent replies with slot list AND 'Free offers available nahi hain.' - injected a discount/offer denial that user never asked about.
defects.expected: Parse 'free' as availability in this context.
defects.impact: Confusing; introduces topic user did not raise.

defects.title: Hallucinated 'call another number' message on live turn
defects.evidence: First LLM response to a valid multi-part enquiry: 'Thank you for calling. Please reach out to 7893686581 for inquiries, and thank you.' - agent gave up on turn 1.
defects.impact: Terminal failure; user routed away for no reason.

defects.title: Multi-part booking promised as complete before all fields captured
defects.evidence: User said 'My number is name is Isabella' (no number). Agent noted name; user said 'thank you'; agent replied 'Mee WhatsApp number share chesthe, PPF and ceramic coating appointment booking complete chestha.' - implies booking readiness though nothing is booked and troll pattern likely.
defects.expected: Do not imply a pending booking is queued; explicitly say 'no booking made'.
defects.impact: User may believe booking is queued; risk of no-show or missed record.

defects.title: Vague-question responses exceed 2-sentence cap with unsolicited price list
defects.evidence: Vague 'What kind of services do you do?' returns a 6-line bulleted price list including every service and rate, instead of asking one clarifier or naming services in one sentence.
defects.expected: One clarifying question OR one-sentence service list.
defects.impact: Format bleed and verbosity violation; overwhelming on voice.

defects.title: Format bleed - Devanagari/Telugu characters spliced into English words
defects.evidence: Scenario 227: 'Book cheyamantారా?' (Telugu 'ారా' suffix on English root). Scenario 236: mixed script within a single word.
defects.impact: TTS will mispronounce; text renders jaggedly.

defects.title: Double-nudge after user acknowledgement
defects.evidence: User 'sare, thanks' -> Agent 'Booking complete cheyadaniki mee 2:00 PM slot 17 Sep ki, Kalyan peru meeda PPF + ceramic coating confirm chesthunna. Ippudu calendar lo book cheyala?' - asks book confirmation a second time after user already agreed.

defects.title: Scenarios tagged Multi_Part actually handled as single-service; not truly multi-part
defects.evidence: Scenarios named 'Multi_Part' but the user only asks about ceramic coating with sub-questions (process, duration). Agent handled them serially, correctly - but this does not test true multi-part behavior.
defects.expected: Test design should ask 3 distinct things in one message.
defects.impact: Coverage gap in test dataset itself, not agent defect.

defects.title: Missing calls / execution failures
defects.evidence: Three scenarios logged 'No matching call found in recent logs. Test may have failed to execute.'

defects.title: n8n / Google Sheet sync failures - captured names not persisted
defects.evidence: Every scenario where a name was extracted shows '[FAILED] <name> missing from Google Sheet'. Even 'Not provided' rows fail.
defects.expected: Extracted names should reach the sheet.

summary_top_5.1_state_reset_on_silence: The most damaging pattern: on any empty/silent user turn, the agent replays its full greeting and forgets everything captured (scenarios 646, 649, 651). Users cannot pause. Fix: treat silence as a soft nudge, cap re-greeting to zero mid-session, and preserve slot state (service, name, number, time) across empty turns.
summary_top_5.2_backend_write_failure: Every extracted name across the Multi_Part slice fails to reach Google Sheet (24+ cases). Booking flow says 'confirmed' but nothing is persisted. This dwarfs every conversational defect - a working chat that never records the appointment is worse than a broken one. Investigate n8n webhook payload and sheet column mapping first.
summary_top_5.3_language_leaks_and_hardcoded_closers: Kannada and Gujarati fragments appear mid-response (153, 165, 171, 177). Separately, Telugu 'Inkemaina help kavala?' is templated in as the closer even in Hindi conversations (157, 160, 230-235). Suggests a hardcoded suffix rather than dynamic language selection. Fix: language-aware closer table.
summary_top_5.4_state_tracking_gaps: When users hand over name+number in one message, the agent only echoes one field for confirmation (226, 233, 239, 245). When time is stated in the multi-part question, it gets dropped by the booking step (240, 246). Multi-part guardrail literally exists to prevent this, so the flow is structurally not honoring 'address all parts'.
summary_top_5.5_vagueness_response_overshoot: For open questions like 'what services?', responses balloon to 6-line bulleted price lists (147, 154, 156, 167, 172, 175, 178) instead of one clarifier + one sentence. Rule 'ask ONE clarifying question, not five' is not applied; verbosity cap breached. Additionally, Nudge_Repeat guardrail is violated in 650 with 3+ book prompts; 224 falsely promises a queued booking with no number captured; hallucinated hang-up injected in 246 ('call 7893686581').
